targets.summary: The _epilogue_op_scope wrapper adds an unnecessary layer of indirection; remove it and call gemm_epilogue_op_scope(cute) directly at the call sites.
targets.evidence: Before, the reviewed code had a wrapper, `def _epilogue_op_scope(cute):\n    return gemm_epilogue_op_scope(cute)`, which was called as `scope = _epilogue_op_scope(cute); exec(epilogue_op, scope); epilogue_op = scope[fn_name]`. The merged diff deletes that wrapper entirely, along with the `gemm_epilogue_op_scope` import and the `ast`-based exec block. The call site is now a single line: `epilogue_op = materialize_epilogue_function(epilogue_op, cute)`, using a shared helper from gemm_epilogue_codegen. This file doesn't call `gemm_epilogue_op_scope(cute)` literally, but the extra wrapper layer the maintainer objected to is gone. The scope building now lives in the shared codegen module instead of a pass-through wrapper, so this is an equivalent fix.
